summary: Increment B 'Quick Fire Foundation' — frontend E2E fully verified on desktop 1440x900 (founder stealth) and mobile 390x844 (founder stealth), plus newbie fixed-slider path (quickfire.newbie@example.com). All 13 review checkpoints pass. (1) Tapping any feed fire button (data-testid feed-fire-<postId>-btn) opens the Quick Fire dialog (data-testid ...-quick) and sends NO fire — post total unchanged while popup is open. (2) Slider defaults to value=1 (max=10 for founder), value display '1× 🔥', send button 'Send 1🔥', meta shows 'Level max 10×', 'Up to 10× now', '36 boost left'. Moving slider with ArrowRight updates value/button ('Send 2🔥', 'Send 4🔥', etc.) and sends nothing while moving. (3) Escape key, backdrop click, and -quick-close all close the popup with total unchanged. (4) Send 2 → popup closes, total 0→2, aria-pressed flips true; reopening initializes slider to current 2, meta shows 'Current 2×', send button DISABLED with 'Current: 2× 🔥', and -quick-remove chip 'Remove my 2× 🔥' is present; moving to 4 enables 'Send 4🔥'. (5) Increase 2→4 (total 2→4), decrease 4→1 (total 4→1), remove (total 1→0) all correct. (6) Double-tap send: second click hit disabled button (Playwright confirmed enabled/stable timeout on 2nd rapid click) — only one increment applied. (7) Chevron -boost-open has aria-label 'Open full Fire Power controls' and opens full picker (-picker) without sending fire; -quick-full-open inside the quick sheet switches quick→full; only ONE sheet open at a time (quick closes when full opens). (8) State propagation: after sending 1x fire from the feed, PostPopup (opened via feed-comment-<postId>) shows the same my_fire and total; PostPopup fire button (post-popup-fire-btn) opens its own Quick Fire (post-popup-fire-quick) with slider initialized to current value and remove chip; removing there syncs back to feed total. Page refresh persists state. (9) MOBILE 390x844: sheet renders as bottom-sheet (y=664, width=390, height=179 — flush against bottom nav), scrollW=clientW=390 (no horizontal overflow), send button reachable at y=782 within 844 viewport, JS .click() confirms send + remove work. (10) Keyboard: slider auto-focuses on open (activeElement = ...-quick-slider), ArrowRight/Left change value, Escape closes. (11) NEWBIE (level 1) fixed slider: slider VISIBLE, value=1, max=1, disabled=true, fixed-note reads 'Fixed at 1× for your level — level up to unlock boosts.', level-max/max-now both '1×', send 'Send 1🔥' works (0→1), remove chip appears and cleans up (1→0). (12) Regression: composer 'SHARE' publishes a plain thought post ('TEST_iter91_quickfire regression thought' by @stealth, visible in feed 0s later). (13) No new console errors introduced by Quick Fire code path — only the pre-existing 401/404 asset probes documented in iter 88-90.

issues: The Quick Fire meta row for a newbie shows '0 boost left' alongside the 'Fixed at 1×' note, because backend quick-state still returns boosted_enabled=true (level_max=1, available_boost=0). Cosmetically misleading — a level-1 user cannot use boosts. Suggest either hiding the '{N} boost left' span when level_max<=1, or gating it on available_boost>0 or explicit newbie flag. Not blocking.

-boost-open chevron IS rendered for the newbie account (boostAvailable=true because /api/fire/status returns boosted_enabled=true even at level 1). Clicking it would open the full picker in newbie 'simple-state' mode which is still valid, so not a blocker, but if the spec intends 'no full-picker affordance for newbies', the chevron condition should also check level_max/max_fire_per_reaction > 1.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: hide '{N} boost left' meta span in QuickFireSheet when max_selectable<=1 (or when available_boost is 0 for a fixed newbie).
Optional: gate FireButton chevron on cfg.max_fire_per_reaction>1 in addition to boostAvailable so newbies do not see an arrow that only reveals the simple-state screen.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickFireSheet.jsx: `blocked` branch prevents rendering meta/slider but the code still renders the container — good. Consider also disabling the outer backdrop's onClose when the sheet is in the transient loading state to avoid an accidental close mid-fetch (currently loading spinner is dismissible, which briefly races with the state fetch).

FireButton.jsx: openSheet does a fresh fetchFireStatus AFTER setting sheet state, so the quick sheet may briefly render the older cached pool before the fresh status arrives. Low risk because QuickFire itself fetches quick-state from the server, but ordering could be tightened (fetch before set).

seed_data_creation: Posted one regression thought as stealth: 'TEST_iter91_quickfire regression thought'. All fire sent during testing was cleaned up (remove chip used at each step). No lingering my_fire reactions on any post after this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids in Feed use prefix feed-fire-<postId>; PostPopup uses post-popup-fire. Suffix selectors in the review spec used $= (e.g. -fire-btn, -boost-open, -quick) — note that the actual Feed testid ends in -btn (not -fire-btn) because the prefix is feed-fire-<postId>; use `[data-testid^="feed-fire-"][data-testid$="-btn"]` to enumerate. When testing on a mobile viewport, the fixed bottom nav intercepts Playwright force-clicks near y>800; use el.evaluate('e => e.click()') to bypass. The newbie account is auto-registered by the test suite via /api/auth/register — it already exists on the preview backend.
